loadout.title: Station Loadout
loadout.intro: Choose the antenna each station starts with. Applying a loadout restarts the sandbox and clears its saved state.
loadout.noStations: This scenario has no ground stations to configure.

noRouter.title: Cannot connect
noRouter.body: The app cannot connect. Check that the router is on and that your laptop is connected to it.

unreachable.title: Can't reach your SkyLink
unreachable.body: You see the last data it sent.

settings.title: Settings

reboot.title: Restart
reboot.body: Restart your SkyLink. It has no service while it starts. This can take several minutes.
reboot.confirm: Restart your SkyLink now? You will lose service until it has started again.

snow.title: Snow melt
snow.body: The heater melts snow on the dish. It uses extra power.
snow.automaticHint: Heat only when snow is on the dish.
snow.preheatHint: Also heat when it is cold.

sleep.title: Power save
sleep.body: Your SkyLink sleeps between these times. It has no service while it sleeps.
sleep.confirm: Save this sleep schedule? Your SkyLink will have no service between {{start}} and {{end}}.
sleep.invalid: Choose a start time and an end time.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.body: The name and password of your router Wi-Fi.
wifi.name: Network name
wifi.invalid: Enter a name and a password of at least 8 characters.

settings.offline: Settings are not available while the SkyLink cannot be reached.

stats.noData: No data in this time range yet.

outages.title: Outages
outages.none: No outages in this time range.

stats.stale: Showing the last data your SkyLink sent.

speed.title: Speed test
speed.body: Measures the speed between your SkyLink and the internet. The test takes about {{seconds}} seconds.
speed.disabled: The speed test is not available. Your SkyLink cannot be reached.
speed.unavailable: The speed test is not available on this connection.
speed.failed: The test did not finish. Check your connection and try again.
speed.noResult: No test has been run yet.

obstructions.title: Obstructions
obstructions.intro: The map shows the sky your SkyLink can see. It fills in over time as the SkyLink follows satellites.
obstructions.unavailable: This SkyLink does not make a sky map.
obstructions.offline: You see the last data the SkyLink sent.
obstructions.mapLabel: Sky map. North is at the top.
obstructions.empty: The map is empty. It needs time to fill.

check.running: Checking. The map needs about {{minutes}} min of time to fill. Let time run. {{left}} min left.
check.done: Check finished. {{blocked}}% of the sky seen is blocked. {{seen}}% of the sky has been seen.
check.doneNone: Check finished. The SkyLink could not see the sky during this time.

reset.confirm: Delete the sky map? The SkyLink starts a new map.
reset.label: Reset

obstructions.cell: Azimuth {{az}} to {{az2}} degrees, elevation {{el}} to {{el2}} degrees: {{state}}

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: Debug data for support. These values are read only.
advanced.offline: You see the last data the SkyLink sent.

devMenu.reloadHint: Toggling a plugin takes effect after a reload.
